WITH ProgramDetails AS ( SELECT tp.program_id, tp.program_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) AS total_sessions, AVG(s.duration) AS avg_session_duration FROM training_programs tp LEFT JOIN sessions s ON tp.program_id = s.program_id GROUP BY tp.program_id, tp.program_name ), ParticipantEngagement AS ( SELECT p.participant_id, p.name, COUNT(a.attendance_id) AS total_sessions_attended, AVG(f.rating) AS avg_feedback_rating FROM participants p LEFT JOIN attendances a ON p.participant_id = a.participant_id LEFT JOIN feedbacks f ON a.session_id = f.session_id AND a.participant_id = f.participant_id GROUP BY p.participant_id, p.name ), TrainingPerformance AS ( SELECT pd.program_id, pd.program_name, pe.participant_id, pe.name, pe.total_sessions_attended, pe.avg_feedback_rating, pd.total_sessions, CASE WHEN pe.total_sessions_attended / pd.total_sessions > 0.8 THEN 'High' WHEN pe.total_sessions_attended / pd.total_sessions > 0.5 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Low' END AS engagement_level FROM ProgramDetails pd INNER JOIN ParticipantEngagement pe ON 1=1 ), ProgramEvaluation AS ( SELECT program_id, AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_program_rating, COUNT(evaluation_id) AS total_evaluations FROM program_evaluations GROUP BY program_id ) SELECT tp.program_name, tp.participant_id, tp.name, tp.engagement_level, pe.avg_program_rating, pe.total_evaluations FROM TrainingPerformance tp LEFT JOIN ProgramEvaluation pe ON tp.program_id = pe.program_id ORDER BY tp.program_name, tp.participant_id

WITH PlayerAverage AS ( SELECT ps.player_id, ps.bowling_average AS overall_bowling_average FROM player_statistics ps ), MatchPerformance AS ( SELECT pmr.player_id, pmr.match_id, pmr.bowling_wickets, pmr.bowling_runs, (pmr.bowling_runs * 1.0 / pmr.bowling_wickets) AS match_bowling_average FROM player_match_records pmr WHERE pmr.role_in_match = 'bowler' ) SELECT p.player_name, ma.match_bowling_average, pa.overall_bowling_average, ma.match_bowling_average - pa.overall_bowling_average AS difference FROM MatchPerformance ma JOIN players p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerAverage pa ON ma.player_id = pa.player_id WHERE ma.match_bowling_average > pa.overall_bowling_average ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 5

WITH OlympicEvents AS ( SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE is_olympic = 1 ), SwimmerOlympicResults AS ( SELECT r.swimmer_id, r.time, r.nisca_score, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.nationality FROM results r JOIN swimmers s ON r.swimmer_id = s.swimmer_id WHERE r.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM OlympicEvents) ), SwimmerPerformance AS ( SELECT swimmer_id, first_name, last_name, nationality, AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS average_time_seconds, AVG(nisca_score) AS average_nisca_score FROM SwimmerOlympicResults GROUP BY swimmer_id, first_name, last_name, nationality ), RankedSwimmers AS ( SELECT swimmer_id, first_name, last_name, nationality, average_time_seconds, average_nisca_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nationality ORDER BY average_time_seconds ASC, average_nisca_score DESC) AS rank_within_nationality FROM SwimmerPerformance ) SELECT first_name, last_name, nationality, average_time_seconds FROM RankedSwimmers WHERE rank_within_nationality <= 5 ORDER BY nationality, average_time_seconds

WITH ConfigSummary AS ( SELECT dgc.config_id, dgc.connector, dgc.rows_per_second, dgc.number_of_rows, dgc.created_by, COUNT(gd.dataset_id) AS total_datasets, SUM(CAST(gd.size_in_bytes AS INTEGER)) / 1048576 AS total_size_mb, MAX(CAST(gd.quality_score AS REAL)) AS max_quality_score, u.username AS created_by_username FROM data_generation_configs dgc JOIN generated_datasets gd ON dgc.config_id = gd.config_id JOIN users u ON dgc.created_by = u.user_id GROUP BY dgc.config_id, dgc.connector, dgc.rows_per_second, dgc.number_of_rows, dgc.created_by, u.username HAVING MAX(CAST(gd.quality_score AS REAL)) > 0.9 ), LatestLog AS ( SELECT config_id, MAX(timestamp) AS latest_log_timestamp FROM data_generation_logs GROUP BY config_id ) SELECT cs.connector, cs.rows_per_second, cs.number_of_rows, cs.total_datasets, cs.total_size_mb, cs.max_quality_score, cs.created_by_username, dl.status AS latest_generation_status FROM ConfigSummary cs LEFT JOIN data_generation_logs dl ON cs.config_id = dl.config_id AND dl.timestamp = ( SELECT latest_log_timestamp FROM LatestLog ll WHERE ll.config_id = cs.config_id ) ORDER BY cs.total_size_mb DESC

WITH ActiveSignals AS ( SELECT rt.road_type_id, COUNT(ts.signal_id) AS signal_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ts.signal_status = 'operational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operational_signals FROM traffic_signals ts JOIN road_types rt ON ts.road_type_id = rt.road_type_id GROUP BY rt.road_type_id ), RoadConditionsSummary AS ( SELECT rc.road_type_id, COUNT(rc.condition_id) AS condition_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN rc.condition_status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS closed_count, AVG(CASE WHEN rc.condition_status = 'closed' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(rc.estimated_repair_time, 1, INSTR(rc.estimated_repair_time, ' ') - 1) AS REAL) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_repair_time FROM road_conditions rc GROUP BY rc.road_type_id ), MaintenanceSummary AS ( SELECT rm.road_type_id, COUNT(rm.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_count, SUM(rm.cost) AS total_cost, AVG(rm.cost) AS avg_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rm.maintenance_type = 'emergency' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS emergency_maint_count FROM road_maintenance rm GROUP BY rm.road_type_id ), RoadStats AS ( SELECT rt.road_type_id, rt.type_name, rt.lanes, rt.speed, rt.priority, rt.allowed_vehicle_classes, COALESCE(ac.signal_count, 0) AS signal_count, COALESCE(ac.operational_signals, 0) AS operational_signals, COALESCE(rcs.condition_count, 0) AS condition_count, COALESCE(rcs.closed_count, 0) AS closed_count, COALESCE(rcs.avg_repair_time, 0) AS avg_repair_time, COALESCE(ms.emergency_maint_count, 0) AS emergency_maint_count, COALESCE(ms.maintenance_count, 0) AS maintenance_count, COALESCE(ms.total_cost, 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(ms.avg_cost, 0) AS avg_cost FROM road_types rt LEFT JOIN ActiveSignals ac ON rt.road_type_id = ac.road_type_id LEFT JOIN RoadConditionsSummary rcs ON rt.road_type_id = rcs.road_type_id LEFT JOIN MaintenanceSummary ms ON rt.road_type_id = ms.road_type_id ) SELECT rs.type_name, rs.lanes, rs.speed, rs.priority, rs.allowed_vehicle_classes, rs.signal_count, rs.operational_signals, rs.condition_count, rs.closed_count, rs.avg_repair_time, rs.emergency_maint_count, rs.maintenance_count, rs.total_cost, rs.avg_cost, SUM(rs.total_cost) OVER (ORDER BY rs.type_name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost FROM RoadStats rs ORDER BY rs.type_name

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS ( SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_category_id, category_name AS full_path FROM categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, ch.full_path || ' > ' || c.category_name AS full_path FROM categories c JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id ), BusinessPerformance AS ( SELECT b.business_id, b.name, b.city, ch.full_path AS category_path, COALESCE(a.visits, 0) AS visits, COALESCE(a.ratings_count, 0) AS ratings_count, COALESCE(a.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(a.revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN analytics a ON b.business_id = a.business_id LEFT JOIN business_categories bc ON b.business_id = bc.business_id LEFT JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON bc.category_id = ch.category_id ), TransactionSummary AS ( SELECT business_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY business_id ), ReviewSummary AS ( SELECT business_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS review_average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY business_id ) SELECT bp.name, bp.city, bp.category_path, bp.revenue, bp.visits, ts.transaction_count, ts.total_transaction_amount, rs.review_count, bp.average_rating, rs.review_average_rating FROM BusinessPerformance bp LEFT JOIN TransactionSummary ts ON bp.business_id = ts.business_id LEFT JOIN ReviewSummary rs ON bp.business_id = rs.business_id ORDER BY bp.revenue DESC, bp.average_rating DESC, bp.visits DESC

WITH SurveyEngagement AS ( SELECT s.survey_id, s.survey_name, COUNT(sp.user_id) AS participant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.participation_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, COUNT(f.feedback_id) AS feedback_count FROM surveys s LEFT JOIN survey_participants sp ON s.survey_id = sp.survey_id LEFT JOIN feedback f ON s.survey_id = f.survey_id GROUP BY s.survey_id, s.survey_name ), SurveyAnalytics AS ( SELECT a.survey_id, a.average_satisfaction, a.average_usefulness, a.average_effectiveness, a.average_visual_attractiveness, a.average_intention, a.total_responses, a.response_rate FROM analytics a ) SELECT se.survey_name, se.participant_count, se.completed_count, (se.completed_count / CAST(se.participant_count AS REAL) * 100) AS completion_rate, se.feedback_count, (se.feedback_count / CAST(se.participant_count AS REAL) * 100) AS feedback_rate, sa.average_satisfaction, sa.average_usefulness, sa.average_effectiveness, sa.average_visual_attractiveness, sa.average_intention, sa.total_responses, sa.response_rate FROM SurveyEngagement se LEFT JOIN SurveyAnalytics sa ON se.survey_id = sa.survey_id ORDER BY completion_rate DESC

WITH RECURSIVE RuleHierarchy AS ( SELECT r.rule_id, r.box_name, r.event_type, r.event_subject, r.event_object, r.priority, r.condition_expression, 1 AS level, CAST(r.rule_id AS TEXT) AS hierarchy_path FROM rules r WHERE r.condition_expression NOT LIKE '%rule_id =%' UNION ALL SELECT rr.rule_id, rr.box_name, rr.event_type, rr.event_subject, rr.event_object, rr.priority, rr.condition_expression, rh.level + 1, rh.hierarchy_path || ' -> ' || CAST(rr.rule_id AS TEXT) FROM rules rr INNER JOIN RuleHierarchy rh ON rr.condition_expression LIKE '%rule_id = ' || CAST(rh.rule_id AS TEXT) || '%' ), RuleStats AS ( SELECT rh.box_name, AVG(rh.priority) AS average_priority, COUNT(*) AS rule_count FROM RuleHierarchy rh GROUP BY rh.box_name ), EventStats AS ( SELECT rh.event_type, COUNT(*) AS rule_count, AVG(rh.priority) AS average_priority FROM RuleHierarchy rh GROUP BY rh.event_type ), FinalStats AS ( SELECT r.rule_id, r.box_name, r.name, r.event_type, r.event_subject, r.event_object, r.priority, r.condition_expression, rh.level, rh.hierarchy_path, rs.rule_count AS box_rule_count, rs.average_priority AS box_avg_priority, es.rule_count AS event_type_rule_count, es.average_priority AS event_type_avg_priority FROM rules r INNER JOIN RuleHierarchy rh ON r.rule_id = rh.rule_id LEFT JOIN RuleStats rs ON r.box_name = rs.box_name LEFT JOIN EventStats es ON r.event_type = es.event_type ) SELECT fs.rule_id, fs.box_name, fs.name, fs.event_type, fs.event_subject, fs.event_object, fs.priority, fs.condition_expression, fs.level, fs.hierarchy_path, fs.box_rule_count, fs.box_avg_priority, fs.event_type_rule_count, fs.event_type_avg_priority, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fs.box_name ORDER BY fs.level, fs.rule_id) AS cumulative_rule_count FROM FinalStats fs ORDER BY fs.box_name, fs.level, fs.rule_id

WITH SafetyProgramsWithCrashes AS ( SELECT tsp.program_id, tsp.program_name, COUNT(cd.crash_id) AS total_crashes, AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(cd.speed_of_vehicles, 1, INSTR(cd.speed_of_vehicles, ' ') - 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_speed_of_vehicles FROM traffic_safety_programs tsp LEFT JOIN crash_data cd ON cd.crash_date BETWEEN tsp.start_date AND tsp.end_date GROUP BY tsp.program_id, tsp.program_name ) SELECT spc.program_name, spc.total_crashes, spc.avg_speed_of_vehicles FROM SafetyProgramsWithCrashes spc ORDER BY spc.total_crashes DESC

WITH TestRunDetails AS ( SELECT tr.run_id, tr.run_number, tr.test_scenario_id, tr.success_rate, tr.test_run_status FROM test_runs tr ), ScenarioPerformance AS ( SELECT trd.test_scenario_id, AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(success_rate, 1, INSTR(success_rate, '%') - 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_success_rate, COUNT(CASE WHEN test_run_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) AS completed_tests_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(success_rate, 1, INSTR(success_rate, '%') - 1) AS REAL)) DESC, COUNT(CASE WHEN test_run_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) DESC) AS scenario_rank FROM TestRunDetails trd GROUP BY trd.test_scenario_id ), TopScenarios AS ( SELECT tsp.test_scenario_id, tsp.avg_success_rate, tsp.completed_tests_count FROM ScenarioPerformance tsp WHERE tsp.scenario_rank <= 10 ) SELECT ts.test_scenario_id, ts.avg_success_rate, ts.completed_tests_count FROM TopScenarios ts ORDER BY ts.avg_success_rate DESC, ts.completed_tests_count DESC

WITH LatestNetworkMetrics AS ( SELECT metric_id, network_id, nodes, isolates, edges, self_loops, degree, max_degree, density, distance, max_distance, clustering, latency, packet_loss, jitter, network_packet_loss, fnm.jitter AS network_jitter, fnm.bandwidth_utilization, fnm.error_rate, fnm.timestamp, fns.node_id, fns.node_name, fns.status AS node_status, fns.last_updated AS node_last_updated, fes.edge_id, fes.source_node_id, fes.target_node_id, fes.status AS edge_status, fes.last_updated AS edge_last_updated, fes.bandwidth, fes.latency, fes.packet_loss, fes.jitter FROM FilteredNetworkMetrics fnm JOIN FilteredNodeStatus fns ON fnm.network_id = 1 AND fns.node_id IN (SELECT node_id FROM network_nodes) JOIN FilteredEdgeStatus fes ON fns.node_id = fes.source_node_id WHERE fnm.network_id = 1 ), ConditionFilteredData AS ( SELECT cd.*, CASE WHEN cd.node_status = 'active' AND cd.edge_status = 'active' THEN 'Critical' WHEN cd.node_status = 'inactive' OR cd.edge_status GROUP_CONCAT(condition, ', ') AS conditions FROM ConditionFilteredData GROUP BY metric_id, network_latency, network_packet_loss, network_jitter, bandwidth_utilization, error_rate, timestamp

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS total_tech_companies, SUM(CASE WHEN c.mental_health_policy = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_companies_with_mental_health_policy, AVG(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' THEN CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(c.no_employees, 1, INSTR(c.no_employees, '-') - 1), ',', '') AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END) AS average_employees_in_tech_companies, AVG(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' THEN e.age ELSE NULL END) AS average_age_in_tech_companies, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' AND c.mental_health_policy = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS total_tech_companies_with_mental_health_policy, AVG(CASE WHEN c.tech_company = 'Yes' AND c.mental_health_policy = 'Yes' THEN md.anxiety_level ELSE NULL END) AS average_anxiety_level_in_tech_companies_with_mental_health_policy FROM companies c LEFT JOIN employees e ON c.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN mental_health_data md ON e.employee_id = md.employee_id

WITH SharedDatasets AS ( SELECT ds.dataset_id, ds.name AS dataset_name, ds.version AS latest_version, COUNT(ds_sh.share_id) AS share_count, MAX(ds_sh.shared_date) AS last_shared_date FROM datasets ds JOIN dataset_sharing ds_sh ON ds.dataset_id = ds_sh.dataset_id GROUP BY ds.dataset_id, ds.name, ds.version HAVING COUNT(ds_sh.share_id) > 1 ), UserDetails AS ( SELECT ds_sh.user_id, ud.name AS user_name FROM dataset_sharing ds_sh JOIN users ud ON ds_sh.user_id = ud.user_id ) SELECT sd.dataset_name, sd.latest_version, GROUP_CONCAT(ud.user_name) AS sharers, sd.share_count, sd.last_shared_date FROM SharedDatasets sd JOIN UserDetails ud ON sd.dataset_id = ( SELECT ds_sh.dataset_id FROM dataset_sharing ds_sh WHERE ds_sh.user_id = ud.user_id AND ds_sh.shared_date = sd.last_shared_date ) GROUP BY sd.dataset_name, sd.latest_version, sd.share_count, sd.last_shared_date ORDER BY sd.last_shared_date DESC

SELECT f.file_name, u.user_name AS owner_name, g.group_name AS group_name, COUNT(fp.permission_id) AS write_permission_count FROM files f INNER JOIN users u ON f.owner_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN groups g ON f.group_id = g.group_id INNER JOIN file_permissions fp ON f.file_id = fp.file_id WHERE f.is_read_only = 0 AND fp.write_permission = 1 GROUP BY f.file_id, f.file_name, u.user_name, g.group_name HAVING COUNT(fp.permission_id) >= 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM add_to_carts WHERE product_id = 1 AND strftime('%Y-%m', atc_date) = '2023-01'

SELECT COUNT(ar.access_request_id) AS pending_requests_count FROM access_requests ar JOIN access_types at ON ar.access_type_id = at.access_type_id JOIN databases db ON ar.database_id = db.database_id WHERE db.database_name = 'Database 1' AND at.access_type_name = 'Admin Console' AND ar.status = 'pending'

WITH GeneRatiosCTE AS ( SELECT g.gene_id, g.gene_name, s.species_name, d.dn_ds_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.gene_id ORDER BY d.dn_ds_ratio DESC) as ratio_rank FROM genes g JOIN dn_ds_ratios d ON g.gene_id = d.gene_id JOIN species s ON d.species_id = s.species_id ), GenesTreesCTE AS ( SELECT gt.tree_id, g.gene_id, g.gene_name, s.species_name, gt.tree_data, INSTR(gt.tree_data, 'ELAVL4') as elavl4_position FROM gene_trees gt JOIN genes g ON gt.gene_id = g.gene_id JOIN species s ON gt.species_id = s.species_id ) SELECT gr.gene_name, gr.species_name, gr.dn_ds_ratio, gt.tree_id, gt.tree_data FROM GeneRatiosCTE gr JOIN GenesTreesCTE gt ON gr.gene_id = gt.gene_id AND gr.species_name = gt.species_name WHERE gr.ratio_rank = 1 AND gt.elavl4_position > 0

SELECT c.country_name, AVG(fs.guns_per_100_inhabitants) AS avg_guns_per_100_inhabitants FROM countries c INNER JOIN firearm_statistics fs ON c.country_id = fs.country_id INNER JOIN population_data pd ON c.country_id = pd.country_id AND fs.year = pd.year WHERE CAST(pd.population AS INTEGER) > 10000000 GROUP BY c.country_name HAVING SUM(fs.number_of_mass_shootings) > 0 ORDER BY avg_guns_per_100_inhabitants DESC

WITH UserCurrencyAssociation AS ( SELECT u.user_id, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(u.email, INSTR(u.email, '@') + 1) LIKE '%com%' THEN 'USD' WHEN SUBSTR(u.email, INSTR(u.email, '@') + 1) LIKE '%eu%' THEN 'EUR' ELSE 'USD' END AS currency_code FROM users u ), AccessLogsWithCurrency AS ( SELECT al.user_id, al.instrument_id, al.access_date, uca.currency_code FROM access_logs al JOIN UserCurrencyAssociation uca ON uca.user_id = al.user_id ), AccessSummary AS ( SELECT acl.currency_code, acl.access_date, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY acl.currency_code ORDER BY acl.access_date) AS cumulative_access_count FROM AccessLogsWithCurrency acl ) SELECT currency_code, access_date, cumulative_access_count FROM AccessSummary ORDER BY currency_code, access_date

SELECT pc.name AS category_name, AVG(cp.customer_engagement) AS avg_customer_engagement, AVG(cp.sales_volume) AS avg_sales_volume FROM product_categories pc INNER JOIN category_performance cp ON pc.category_id = cp.category_id INNER JOIN access_logs al ON pc.category_id = al.category_id INNER JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.role = 'admin' AND strftime('%Y', al.access_time) = '2023' GROUP BY pc.name HAVING AVG(cp.customer_engagement) > 300 ORDER BY avg_customer_engagement DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.product_id) AS unique_products FROM databases d JOIN database_updates du ON d.database_id = du.database_id

SELECT sp.product_name, COALESCE( (SELECT du.description FROM database_updates du INNER JOIN databases d ON du.database_id = d.database_id WHERE d.product_id = sp.product_id ORDER BY du.update_date DESC LIMIT 1), 'No Updates Found' ) AS latest_update_description FROM software_products sp WHERE sp.development_status = 'released' ORDER BY sp.product_name

WITH MaintenanceImpact AS ( SELECT ep.panel_id, ep.timestamp, m.maintenance_status, ep.power_out, ep.power_usage, ((ep.power_out - ep.power_usage) / ep.power_out * 100) AS efficiency_percentage FROM energy_production ep LEFT JOIN maintenance m ON ep.timestamp >= m.timestamp AND ep.panel_id = m.panel_id WHERE ep.panel_id = 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN maintenance_status = 'completed' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS maintenance_completed, AVG(efficiency_percentage) AS avg_efficiency FROM MaintenanceImpact GROUP BY maintenance_completed ORDER BY maintenance_completed

WITH TopRankedTeams AS ( SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE rank <= 3 ), UserActivity AS ( SELECT al.user_id, al.access_date, SUBSTR(u.user_name, 1, 15) AS short_user_name, al.duration, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY al.team_id ORDER BY al.duration DESC) AS activity_rank FROM access_logs al JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.user_id JOIN TopRankedTeams trt ON al.team_id = trt.team_id ) SELECT access_date, short_user_name FROM UserActivity WHERE activity_rank <= 3 ORDER BY access_date DESC, activity_rank

WITH StationHumidity AS ( SELECT ed.station_id, AVG(ed.humidity) AS avg_humidity, MAX(ed.humidity) AS max_humidity FROM environmental_data ed WHERE ed.record_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY ed.station_id ), FilteredStations AS ( SELECT sh.station_id, sh.avg_humidity, sh.max_humidity FROM StationHumidity sh WHERE sh.max_humidity > 80 ) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( ms.contact_person || ', ' || ms.location || ', ' || ms.installation_date || ', ' || CAST(fs.max_humidity AS TEXT) || ', ' || CAST(fs.avg_humidity AS TEXT), '; ' ) AS station_details FROM FilteredStations fs JOIN monitoring_stations ms ON fs.station_id = ms.station_id

SELECT a.article_id, s.source_name, GROUP_CONCAT(i.industry_name) AS industries, COUNT(v.view_id) AS view_count FROM articles a JOIN sources s ON a.source_id = s.source_id JOIN article_industries ai ON a.article_id = ai.article_id JOIN industries i ON ai.industry_id = i.industry_id JOIN article_views v ON a.article_id = v.article_id GROUP BY a.article_id, s.source_name HAVING COUNT(v.view_id) > 0

WITH StudentQualifications AS ( SELECT s.student_id, q.course_id, q.date_awarded, g.percentage_range FROM students s INNER JOIN qualifications q ON s.student_id = q.student_id INNER JOIN grades g ON q.grade_id = g.grade_id ), ExtractedPercentage AS ( SELECT student_id, course_id, date_awarded, CAST(SUBSTR(percentage_range, 1, INSTR(percentage_range, '-') - 1) AS REAL) AS average_percentage FROM StudentQualifications ), CumulativeAverages AS ( SELECT student_id, course_id, SUM(average_percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY date_awarded) AS cumulative_average FROM ExtractedPercentage ) SELECT course_id, MAX(cumulative_average) AS top_cumulative_average FROM CumulativeAverages GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY top_cumulative_average DESC

WITH ApplicationCounts AS ( SELECT job_id, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM applications GROUP BY job_id ), ApplicationStatusDistribution AS ( SELECT job_id, status, COUNT(*) AS status_count FROM applications GROUP BY job_id, status ), JobDetails AS ( SELECT p.job_id, p.job_title, c.category_name, l.location_name, l.contact_email, p.skills_required FROM job_postings p INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id INNER JOIN locations l ON p.location_id = l.location_id ), ApplicantSkills AS ( SELECT a.job_id, u.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(us.skill) AS applicant_skills FROM applications a INNER JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_skills us ON u.user_id = us.user_id GROUP BY a.job_id, u.user_id ), JobApplicantSkillMatch AS ( SELECT js.job_id, js.skills_required, askill.user_id, CASE WHEN askill.applicant_skills LIKE '%' || js.skills_required || '%' THEN 'Match' ELSE 'No Match' END AS skill_match FROM JobDetails js INNER JOIN ApplicantSkills askill ON js.job_id = askill.job_id ) SELECT jd.job_id, jd.job_title, jd.category_name, jd.location_name, jd.contact_email, ac.application_count, acd.status, acd.status_count, js.skill_match FROM JobDetails jd LEFT JOIN ApplicationCounts ac ON jd.job_id = ac.job_id LEFT JOIN ApplicationStatusDistribution acd ON jd.job_id = acd.job_id LEFT JOIN JobApplicantSkillMatch js ON jd.job_id = js.job_id ORDER BY jd.job_id, acd.status

WITH StoreData AS ( SELECT s.store_id, s.name, s.address, st.type_name, GROUP_CONCAT(ps.service_name, ', ') AS pharmacy_services, COUNT(ss.staff_id) AS staff_count, COUNT(sa.sale_id) AS total_sales, SUM(CAST(sa.total_amount AS REAL)) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(sc.supplier_id) AS supply_chain_count, SUM(sc.quantity) AS total_supply_quantity FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_store_types stt ON s.store_id = stt.store_id LEFT JOIN store_types st ON st.type_id = stt.type_id LEFT JOIN store_pharmacy_services sps ON s.store_id = sps.store_id LEFT JOIN pharmacy_services ps ON ps.service_id = sps.service_id LEFT JOIN store_staff ss ON ss.store_id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN sales sa ON sa.store_id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN supply_chain sc ON sc.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name, s.address, st.type_name ), RankedStores AS ( SELECT sd.store_id, sd.name, sd.address, sd.type_name, sd.pharmacy_services, sd.staff_count, sd.total_sales, sd.total_sales_amount, sd.supply_chain_count, sd.total_supply_quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sd.total_sales_amount ASC) AS sales_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sd.total_supply_quantity DESC) AS supply_chain_bucket FROM StoreData sd ) SELECT rs.name, rs.type_name, rs.pharmacy_services, rs.staff_count, rs.total_sales, rs.total_sales_amount, rs.supply_chain_count, rs.total_supply_quantity, rs.sales_rank, rs.supply_chain_bucket, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rs.supply_chain_bucket) AS bucket_size, AVG(rs.total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY rs.supply_chain_bucket) AS bucket_avg_sales_amount FROM RankedStores rs ORDER BY rs.sales_rank ASC

SELECT strftime('%H', test_date) AS HourOfDay, AVG(time) AS AverageTime FROM performance_tests WHERE test_status = 'completed' GROUP BY HourOfDay ORDER BY HourOfDay

WITH MonthlyHealthSummary AS ( SELECT h.state_id, s.state_name, strftime('%Y-%m', h.date_recorded) AS month, SUM(h.total_confirmed) AS total_confirmed_monthly, SUM(h.active_cases) AS active_cases_monthly, AVG(CAST(h.vaccination_rate AS REAL)) AS avg_vaccination_rate, AVG(CAST(h.test_positivity_rate AS REAL)) AS avg_test_positivity_rate FROM health_data h INNER JOIN states s ON h.state_id = s.state_id GROUP BY h.state_id, s.state_name, month ), UserAccessSummary AS ( SELECT a.user_id, u.user_name, u.role, COUNT(a.access_id) AS access_count FROM access_logs a INNER JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY a.user_id, u.user_name, u.role ) SELECT mhs.state_name, mhs.month, mhs.total_confirmed_monthly, mhs.active_cases_monthly, mhs.avg_vaccination_rate, mhs.avg_test_positivity_rate, uas.user_name, uas.role, uas.access_count FROM MonthlyHealthSummary mhs LEFT JOIN UserAccessSummary uas ON mhs.state_id = uas.user_id ORDER BY mhs.state_name, mhs.month, uas.access_count DESC

WITH TopPerformers AS ( SELECT r.track_id, r.race_id, rr.horse_id, h.horse_name, h.trainer_id, t.trainer_full_name, rr.post_pos, rr.place, rr.final_odds, rr.purse, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.race_id ORDER BY rr.place, rr.final_odds DESC) as performance_rank FROM races r INNER JOIN race_results rr ON r.race_id = rr.race_id INNER JOIN horses h ON rr.horse_id = h.horse_id INNER JOIN trainers t ON h.trainer_id = t.trainer_id WHERE r.track_id = 0 AND r.race_type = 'flat' ), TopPerformersDetailed AS ( SELECT tp.track_id, tp.race_id, tp.horse_id, tp.horse_name, tp.trainer_id, tp.trainer_full_name, tp.post_pos, tp.place, tp.final_odds, tp.purse, tp.performance_rank, o.owner_name, o.owner_id, ho.percentage FROM TopPerformers tp LEFT JOIN horse_owners ho ON tp.horse_id = ho.horse_id LEFT JOIN owners o ON ho.owner_id = o.owner_id ), RecentHistory AS ( SELECT hist.horse_id, hist.race_id, hist.race_name, hist.finish_pos, hist.distance, hist.finish_time, hist.race_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hist.horse_id ORDER BY hist.race_date DESC) as history_rank FROM racing_history hist WHERE hist.horse_id IN (SELECT horse_id FROM TopPerformers) ), FinalResult AS ( SELECT tpd.track_id, tpd.race_id, tpd.horse_id, tpd.horse_name, tpd.trainer_id, tpd.trainer_full_name, tpd.post_pos, tpd.place, tpd.final_odds, tpd.purse, tpd.performance_rank, tpd.owner_name, tpd.owner_id, tpd.percentage, hist.race_name AS recent_race_name, hist.finish_pos AS recent_finish_pos, hist.distance AS recent_distance, hist.finish_time AS recent_finish_time, hist.race_date AS recent_race_date FROM TopPerformersDetailed tpd LEFT JOIN RecentHistory hist ON tpd.horse_id = hist.horse_id AND hist.history_rank = 1 ) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(FinalResult.horse_name || ' (Owner: ' || FinalResult.owner_name || ', Trainer: ' || FinalResult.trainer_full_name || ', Recent Race: ' || FinalResult.recent_race_name || ', Recent Place: ' || FinalResult.recent_finish_pos || ', Recent Distance: ' || FinalResult.recent_distance || ' furlongs, Recent Time: ' || FinalResult.recent_finish_time, '; ') AS detailed_horse_info FROM FinalResult WHERE FinalResult.performance_rank <= 3

WITH RECURSIVE CategoryHierarchy AS ( SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, c.category_name AS full_path FROM categories c WHERE c.parent_category_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id, ch.full_path || ' > ' || c.category_name AS full_path FROM categories c INNER JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON c.parent_category_id = ch.category_id ), CategoryPaths AS ( SELECT pi.item_id, ch.full_path AS category_path FROM plenary_items pi INNER JOIN CategoryHierarchy ch ON pi.category_id = ch.category_id ), LastAccess AS ( SELECT ial.item_id, u.username AS last_accessor, ial.access_date AS last_access_date FROM item_access_logs ial INNER JOIN users u ON ial.user_id = u.user_id WHERE (ial.item_id, ial.access_date) IN ( SELECT item_id, MAX(access_date) FROM item_access_logs GROUP BY item_id ) ), LastVote AS ( SELECT v.item_id, u.username AS last_voter, v.vote_date AS last_vote_date, v.vote_cast FROM votes v INNER JOIN users u ON v.user_id = u.user_id WHERE (v.item_id, v.vote_date) IN ( SELECT item_id, MAX(vote_date) FROM votes GROUP BY item_id ) ), DocumentCounts AS ( SELECT d.item_id, COUNT(d.document_id) AS document_count FROM documents d GROUP BY d.item_id ), AmendmentCounts AS ( SELECT a.item_id, COUNT(a.amendment_id) AS amendment_count FROM amendments a GROUP BY a.item_id ) SELECT pi.item_id, pi.title, cp.category_path, si.session_id, ps.session_date, ps.location, si.sequence_number, la.last_accessor, la.last_access_date, lv.last_voter, lv.last_vote_date, lv.vote_cast, COALESCE(dc.document_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(ac.amendment_count, 0) AS amendment_count FROM plenary_items pi INNER JOIN CategoryPaths cp ON pi.item_id = cp.item_id INNER JOIN session_items si ON pi.item_id = si.item_id INNER JOIN plenary_sessions ps ON si.session_id = ps.session_id LEFT JOIN LastAccess la ON pi.item_id = la.item_id LEFT JOIN LastVote lv ON pi.item_id = lv.item_id LEFT JOIN DocumentCounts dc ON pi.item_id = dc.item_id LEFT JOIN AmendmentCounts ac ON pi.item_id = ac.item_id WHERE si.session_id = 1 ORDER BY si.sequence_number, pi.item_id

WITH ConfigurationDetails AS ( SELECT c.config_id, c.config_version, c.created_date, c.last_modified_date, c.build_environment, u.username AS created_by_username, u2.username AS last_modified_by_username, f.file_name, f.file_path FROM configurations c JOIN users u ON c.created_by = u.user_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON c.last_modified_by = u2.user_id JOIN files f ON c.file_id = f.file_id ), VersionHistory AS ( SELECT v.config_id, MAX(CAST(v.version_number AS INTEGER)) AS latest_version_number, MAX(v.change_date) AS latest_change_date FROM version_history v GROUP BY v.config_id ), BuildLogDetails AS ( SELECT bl.config_id, MAX(bl.build_date) AS latest_build_date, MAX(bl.build_status) AS latest_build_status, MAX(bl.message) AS latest_build_message, MAX(bl.build_duration) AS latest_build_duration FROM build_logs bl GROUP BY bl.config_id ), UserPermissions AS ( SELECT p.config_id, COUNT(p.permission_id) AS permission_count, MAX(CASE WHEN p.can_edit = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS can_edit, MAX(CASE WHEN p.can_view = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) AS can_view FROM user_permissions p GROUP BY p.config_id ), DependencyCounts AS ( SELECT d.config_id, COUNT(d.dependency_id) AS dependency_count FROM dependencies d GROUP BY d.config_id ) SELECT cd.config_id, cd.config_version, cd.created_date, cd.last_modified_date, cd.build_environment, cd.created_by_username, cd.last_modified_by_username, cd.file_name, cd.file_path, vh.latest_version_number, vh.latest_change_date, bl.latest_build_date, bl.latest_build_status, bl.latest_build_message, bl.latest_build_duration, up.permission_count, up.can_edit, up.can_view, dc.dependency_count, CASE WHEN bl.latest_build_status = 'Success' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS configuration_status FROM ConfigurationDetails cd LEFT JOIN VersionHistory vh ON cd.config_id = vh.config_id LEFT JOIN BuildLogDetails bl ON cd.config_id = bl.config_id LEFT JOIN UserPermissions up ON cd.config_id = up.config_id LEFT JOIN DependencyCounts dc ON cd.config_id = dc.config_id ORDER BY cd.config_id

WITH SupplierPerformance AS ( SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN od.delivery_status = 'Delivered' AND od.expected_delivery_date >= po.order_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_delivered_on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN qc.status = 'Passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS relays_passed_qc, COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_detail_id) AS total_relays FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id LEFT JOIN order_details od ON po.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN quality_control qc ON od.relay_id = qc.relay_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ) SELECT supplier_name, total_orders, CAST(orders_delivered_on_time AS REAL) * 100 / total_orders AS on_time_delivery_percentage, CAST(relays_passed_qc AS REAL) * 100 / total_relays AS qc_pass_percentage FROM SupplierPerformance ORDER BY on_time_delivery_percentage DESC, qc_pass_percentage DESC

WITH ClientUnitsCTE AS ( SELECT u.current_client_id, c.client_name, COUNT(u.unit_id) AS unit_count, GROUP_CONCAT(u.unit_number || ' - ' || u.status, ', ') AS unit_details FROM units u INNER JOIN clients c ON u.current_client_id = c.client_id WHERE u.status = 'in transit' GROUP BY u.current_client_id, c.client_name ), RankedClientsCTE AS ( SELECT current_client_id, client_name, unit_count, unit_details, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unit_count DESC) AS client_rank FROM ClientUnitsCTE ) SELECT client_name, unit_count, unit_details FROM RankedClientsCTE WHERE client_rank <= 3

WITH ChurnedCustomers AS ( SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, ch.churn_date FROM customers c INNER JOIN churn ch ON c.customer_id = ch.customer_id WHERE ch.has_churned = 1 ), FinancialImpact AS ( SELECT cc.customer_id, SUM(b.total_charge) AS total_churned_revenue FROM ChurnedCustomers cc INNER JOIN bills b ON cc.customer_id = b.customer_id WHERE b.bill_date <= cc.churn_date GROUP BY cc.customer_id ), ServiceImpact AS ( SELECT cc.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.service_id) AS total_services, SUM(u.usage_amount) AS total_usage FROM ChurnedCustomers cc LEFT JOIN customer_services cs ON cc.customer_id = cs.customer_id LEFT JOIN usage u ON cc.customer_id = u.customer_id AND cs.service_id = u.service_id GROUP BY cc.customer_id ) SELECT cc.customer_id, cc.first_name || ' ' || cc.last_name AS full_name, fi.total_churned_revenue, si.total_services FROM ChurnedCustomers cc LEFT JOIN FinancialImpact fi ON cc.customer_id = fi.customer_id LEFT JOIN ServiceImpact si ON cc.customer_id = si.customer_id ORDER BY fi.total_churned_revenue DESC, si.total_services DESC

WITH RankedStations AS ( SELECT w.date, w.station_id, w.precipitation, st.station_name, w.category_id, SUM(w.precipitation) OVER (PARTITION BY w.date) AS total_daily_precipitation, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.date ORDER BY w.precipitation DESC) AS precipitation_rank FROM weather_data w INNER JOIN weather_stations st ON w.station_id = st.station_id ), TopPrecipitation AS ( SELECT rs.date, rs.station_id, rs.precipitation, rs.station_name, rs.category_id, rs.total_daily_precipitation FROM RankedStations rs WHERE rs.precipitation_rank = 1 ) SELECT tp.date, tp.station_name, tp.precipitation, tp.total_daily_precipitation, (tp.precipitation * 100.0 / tp.total_daily_precipitation) AS percentage_contribution, wdc.category_name FROM TopPrecipitation tp INNER JOIN weather_data_categories wdc ON tp.category_id = wdc.category_id ORDER BY tp.date DESC

WITH EconomicData AS ( SELECT ei.county_id, ei.median_household_income, ei.median_home_value, ed.high_school_graduation_rate, dd.unemployment_rate FROM economic_indicators ei JOIN education_data ed ON ei.county_id = ed.county_id AND ei.year = ed.year JOIN demographic_data dd ON ei.county_id = dd.county_id AND dd.year = 2020 WHERE ei.year = 2020 AND ed.year = 2020 ), CombinedData AS ( SELECT e.county_id, c.county_name, c.state_name, e.median_household_income, e.median_home_value, e.high_school_graduation_rate, e.unemployment_rate, MIN(e.high_school_graduation_rate, e.unemployment_rate) AS min_rate, (e.median_home_value - e.median_household_income) * (e.high_school_graduation_rate / 100) AS impact_index FROM EconomicData e JOIN counties c ON e.county_id = c.county_id ), FinalAnalysis AS ( SELECT cd.county_name, cd.state_name, cd.min_rate, cd.impact_index FROM CombinedData cd ) SELECT fa.county_name, fa.state_name, MAX(fa.min_rate) AS max_min_rate, SUM(fa.impact_index) AS total_impact_index FROM FinalAnalysis fa GROUP BY fa.county_name, fa.state_name ORDER BY total_impact_index DESC

WITH LatestRankings AS ( SELECT r.player_id, r.rank, r.points FROM rankings r INNER JOIN ( SELECT player_id, MAX(date) AS max_date FROM rankings GROUP BY player_id ) latest ON r.player_id = latest.player_id AND r.date = latest.max_date ), PlayerWins AS ( SELECT m.player1_id AS player_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN m.score LIKE '%-0,%-0' THEN 1 END) AS wins FROM matches m GROUP BY m.player1_id ), PlayerStats AS ( SELECT s.player_id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_type = 'aces' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS aces, SUM(CASE WHEN s.stat_type = 'double faults' THEN s.stat_value ELSE 0 END) AS double_faults FROM statistics s GROUP BY s.player_id ) SELECT p.player_name, (lr.rank * 0.5 + IFNULL(pw.wins, 0) * 1.5 + IFNULL(ps.aces, 0) * 0.2 - IFNULL(ps.double_faults, 0) * 0.1) AS performance_score FROM players p LEFT JOIN LatestRankings lr ON p.player_id = lr.player_id LEFT JOIN PlayerWins pw ON p.player_id = pw.player_id LEFT JOIN PlayerStats ps ON p.player_id = ps.player_id ORDER BY performance_score DESC

SELECT dp.id AS data_point_id, dp.bool_col AS bool_value, ds.data_source_name AS source_name, dc.data_category_name AS category_name, dsc.data_subcategory_name AS subcategory_name, du.data_unit_name AS unit_name, COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(dpc.comment, '; '), 'No comments') AS comments FROM data_points dp JOIN data_sources ds ON dp.data_source_id = ds.data_source_id JOIN data_categories dc ON dp.data_category_id = dc.data_category_id JOIN data_subcategories dsc ON dp.data_subcategory_id = dsc.data_subcategory_id JOIN data_units du ON dp.data_unit_id = du.data_unit_id LEFT JOIN data_point_comments dpc ON dp.id = dpc.data_point_id WHERE dp.bool_col = 1 GROUP BY dp.id, dp.bool_col, ds.data_source_name, dc.data_category_name, dsc.data_subcategory_name, du.data_unit_name

WITH WeatherTopData AS ( SELECT w.station_id, w.year, w.avg_temp, w.max_temp, w.min_temp, w.rainfall, w.snowfall, w.thunderstorms, w.fog_days, w.tornadoes, w.hail_reports, w.quality_flags, w.data_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.station_id, w.year ORDER BY w.avg_temp DESC) AS rn FROM weather_data w ), TopRecords AS ( SELECT wd.station_id, wd.year, wd.avg_temp, wd.max_temp, wd.min_temp, wd.rainfall, wd.snowfall, wd.thunderstorms, wd.fog_days, wd.tornadoes, wd.hail_reports, wd.quality_flags, wd.data_id FROM WeatherTopData wd WHERE wd.rn = 1 ), StationInfo AS ( SELECT ws.station_id, ws.station_name, ws.location FROM weather_stations ws ), ProcessingStats AS ( SELECT dpj.data_id, COUNT(*) AS total_jobs, SUM(CASE WHEN dpj.job_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_jobs, SUM(CASE WHEN dpj.job_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_jobs FROM data_processing_jobs dpj GROUP BY dpj.data_id ), AccessStats AS ( SELECT a.data_id, COUNT(*) AS total_accesses, AVG(CAST(strftime('%s', a.access_duration) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_access_duration FROM access_logs a GROUP BY a.data_id ), FinalQuery AS ( SELECT tr.year, si.station_name, si.location, tr.avg_temp, tr.max_temp, tr.min_temp, tr.rainfall, tr.snowfall, tr.thunderstorms, tr.fog_days, tr.tornadoes, tr.hail_reports, tr.quality_flags, COALESCE(ps.total_jobs, 0) AS total_jobs, COALESCE(ps.completed_jobs, 0) AS completed_jobs, COALESCE(ps.failed_jobs, 0) AS failed_jobs, COALESCE(ac.total_accesses, 0) AS total_accesses, COALESCE(ac.avg_access_duration, 0) AS avg_access_duration FROM TopRecords tr INNER JOIN StationInfo si ON tr.station_id = si.station_id LEFT JOIN ProcessingStats ps ON tr.data_id = ps.data_id LEFT JOIN AccessStats ac ON tr.data_id = ac.data_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS overall_record_count FROM FinalQuery

WITH ParameterAccess AS ( SELECT param_id, COUNT(*) AS access_count, MAX(access_date) AS last_access_date FROM access_logs GROUP BY param_id ), ParameterValues AS ( SELECT param_id, AVG(value) AS average_value FROM parameter_values GROUP BY param_id ), ParameterNotes AS ( SELECT param_id, note FROM notes WHERE priority = 1 ), ParameterConditions AS ( SELECT param_id, condition FROM conditions WHERE priority = 1 ), DiagramDetails AS ( SELECT pv.param_id, GROUP_CONCAT(td.diag_name, ', ') AS diag_names, GROUP_CONCAT(td.category, ', ') AS categories, GROUP_CONCAT(td.version, ', ') AS versions FROM parameter_values pv INNER JOIN timing_diagrams td ON pv.diag_id = td.diag_id GROUP BY pv.param_id ) SELECT tp.param_name, tp.description, COALESCE(pa.access_count, 0) AS access_count, COALESCE(pa.last_access_date, 'Never') AS last_access_date, COALESCE(pv.average_value, 0) AS average_value, COALESCE(dd.diag_names, 'None') AS diag_names, COALESCE(dd.categories, 'None') AS categories, COALESCE(dd.versions, 'None') AS versions, COALESCE(pn.note, 'None') AS note, COALESCE(pc.condition, 'None') AS condition FROM timing_parameters tp LEFT JOIN ParameterAccess pa ON tp.param_id = pa.param_id LEFT JOIN ParameterValues pv ON tp.param_id = pv.param_id LEFT JOIN DiagramDetails dd ON tp.param_id = dd.param_id LEFT JOIN ParameterNotes pn ON tp.param_id = pn.param_id LEFT JOIN ParameterConditions pc ON tp.param_id = pc.param_id ORDER BY tp.param_name

WITH EmissionsTotal AS ( SELECT facility_id, SUM(amount) AS total_emission FROM emissions WHERE emission_type IN ('CO2', 'NOx') GROUP BY facility_id ), WasteTotal AS ( SELECT facility_id, SUM(amount) AS total_waste FROM waste_generation JOIN waste_types wt ON wt.waste_type_id = waste_generation.waste_type_id WHERE wt.waste_type_name IN ('Solid Waste', 'Liquid Waste') GROUP BY facility_id ), FacilityImpact AS ( SELECT COALESCE(et.facility_id, wt.facility_id) AS facility_id, COALESCE(et.total_emission, 0) AS total_emission, COALESCE(wt.total_waste, 0) AS total_waste, COALESCE(et.total_emission, 0) + COALESCE(wt.total_waste, 0) AS total_environmental_impact FROM EmissionsTotal et FULL OUTER JOIN WasteTotal wt ON et.facility_id = wt.facility_id ) SELECT f.facility_name, fi.total_environmental_impact FROM FacilityImpact fi JOIN facilities f ON fi.facility_id = f.facility_id ORDER BY fi.total_environmental_impact DESC

WITH AnnotatedImagesCTE AS ( SELECT ia.annotation_id, ia.image_id, ia.user_id, ia.annotation_date, ia.comments, ia.annotation_type, ia.confidence_level, i.class_id, i.path, i.format, i.resolution, i.dataset_id, i.capture_date, i.source, c.class_name, c.description, u.username, u.email, u.role, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ia.image_id ORDER BY ia.confidence_level DESC) AS annotation_rank FROM image_annotations AS ia INNER JOIN images AS i ON ia.image_id = i.image_id INNER JOIN classes AS c ON i.class_id = c.class_id INNER JOIN users AS u ON ia.user_id = u.user_id ), FilteredAnnotations AS ( SELECT ai.image_id, ai.class_id, ai.path, ai.format, ai.resolution, ai.dataset_id, ai.capture_date, ai.source, ai.class_name, ai.description, ai.username, ai.email, ai.role, GROUP_CONCAT( ai.comments || ' (' || ai.annotation_date || ', ' || ai.annotation_type || ', Confidence: ' || ai.confidence_level || ')' ) AS annotation_details FROM AnnotatedImagesCTE AS ai WHERE ai.annotation_rank <= 3 GROUP BY ai.image_id, ai.class_id, ai.path, ai.format, ai.resolution, ai.dataset_id, ai.capture_date, ai.source, ai.class_name, ai.description, ai.username, ai.email, ai.role ) SELECT fa.image_id, fa.class_id, fa.path, fa.format, fa.resolution, fa.dataset_id, fa.capture_date, fa.source, fa.class_name, fa.description, fa.username, fa.email, fa.role, fa.annotation_details, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fa.image_id) AS total_annotations_per_image FROM FilteredAnnotations AS fa

WITH ConfigBuildLogs AS ( SELECT bl.config_id, bl.build_environment, COUNT(*) AS build_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN bl.build_status = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS build_successes, SUM(CASE WHEN bl.build_status = 'Failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS build_failures FROM build_logs bl GROUP BY bl.config_id, bl.build_environment ), ConfigDependencies AS ( SELECT c.config_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dependencies, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_shared = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shared_dependencies FROM configurations c LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON c.config_id = d.config_id GROUP BY c.config_id ), ConfigurationsWithDetails AS ( SELECT c.config_id, c.config_version, c.build_environment, cb.build_attempts, cb.build_successes, cb.build_failures, cd.total_dependencies, cd.shared_dependencies, c.created_by, c.last_modified_by, u1.username AS creator, u2.username AS last_modifier FROM configurations c LEFT JOIN ConfigBuildLogs cb ON c.config_id = cb.config_id LEFT JOIN ConfigDependencies cd ON c.config_id = cd.config_id LEFT JOIN users u1 ON c.created_by = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON c.last_modified_by = u2.user_id ), UserRoles AS ( SELECT up.user_id, up.config_id, u.role, MAX(up.created_date) AS permission_creation_date FROM user_permissions up INNER JOIN users u ON up.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY up.user_id, up.config_id, u.role ) SELECT c.config_id, ( SELECT 'Configuration ' || c.config_version || ' in ' || c.build_environment || ': ' || CASE WHEN c.build_attempts = 0 THEN 'No builds yet.' WITH SoldItems AS ( SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS total_sold FROM requests WHERE action = 'Sold' AND status = 'Approved' GROUP BY item_id ), PendingRequests AS ( SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS total_requests FROM requests WHERE status = 'Pending' GROUP BY item_id ), ItemCondition AS ( SELECT item_id, condition FROM item_condition ic WHERE condition_date = ( SELECT MAX(condition_date) FROM item_condition WHERE item_id = ic.item_id ) ) SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, c.category_name, l.location_name, i.quantity, COALESCE(SoldItems.total_sold, 0) AS total_sold, COALESCE(PendingRequests.total_requests, 0) AS total_pending_requests, ItemCondition.condition FROM inventory_items i LEFT JOIN SoldItems ON i.item_id = SoldItems.item_id LEFT JOIN PendingRequests ON i.item_id = PendingRequests.item_id LEFT JOIN ItemCondition ON i.item_id = ItemCondition.item_id INNER JOIN categories c ON i.category_id = c.category_id INNER JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.location_id WHERE i.quantity < 10 AND (SoldItems.total_sold > 0 OR PendingRequests.total_requests > 0)
